name: Telegram to GitHub Publisher Bot
description: Telegram bot that publishes channel posts as JSON data for any GitHub Pages site

CHANNEL_ID.description: Numeric ID of the Telegram channel to watch (e.g. -1001234567890)

ADMIN_IDS.description: Comma-separated numeric Telegram user IDs of admins who can forward posts

WEBHOOK_URL.description: Full public URL of this app that Telegram will call (e.g. https://my-app.herokuapp.com/)

DATA_FOLDER.description: Local path where generated JSON data files are written

IMAGES_FOLDER.description: Local path where downloaded images are stored

IMAGES_SLUG.description: URL prefix prepended to image filenames in the generated JSON

RUN_COMMAND.description: Shell command to run after data files are updated, e.g. cd _web && git add -A && git commit -m "%s" && git push

PAGE_SIZE.description: Number of posts per generated JSON page file
